title: Study in Patients With COPD
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the efficacy and safety of the investigational drug in the treatment of COPD in comparison with a placebo.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Medical diagnosis of COPD
* Current or prior history of cigarette smoking

Exclusion Criteria:

* Medical diagnosis of asthma
* Chest x-ray (CXR) prior to Day 1 diagnostic of significant disease other than COPD
* Significant condition or disease other than COPD
